method: Read-only analysis scripts in reg/ (analyze.py: same-quote, contained-quote and claim-similarity clusters; hardcheck.py; propose.py and build_patches.py for the display rule). Decisions in reg/supersede.json, reg/display-overrides.json and reg/claim-fixes.json; one patch per fact in reg/patches/. Every change applied with one saa.py command (facts amend --supersede / --reject / --file, facts conflicts --resolve).
rules_applied: Duplicates: 82 route53 facts superseded where two or more facts quote the same sentence or one fact bundles the sentences of single-sentence facts; the kept fact has the cleaner quote (no Markdown), the claim closest to its quote, or the fuller passage. Bundle facts whose claim went beyond their quotes were superseded by the single-sentence facts (entail risk). List and reasons: reg/supersede.json.

Routing policies: the eight routing-policy-*-use facts (quotes with bold Markdown) were superseded by the choose-*-routing facts; private hosted zone support per policy stays in route53-phz-routing-policy-support.

Namespace: 7 facts quoted from the Amazon VPC guide (Amazon DNS server addresses, 1024 packets per second, NACL/SG filtering, enableDnsSupport and enableDnsHostnames defaults, both attributes required for private hosted zones) duplicated verified vpc facts of chapter 10 and were superseded by them: chapter 13 links vpc-dns-resolver-addresses, vpc-dns-resolver-1024-pps-per-eni, vpc-dns-server-not-filterable, vpc-dns-attributes-required-for-private-hosted-zones, vpc-dns-support-attribute-default, vpc-dns-hostnames-attribute-default. The route53-vs-ga-* comparison facts stay in route53 with explicit scope (chapter 15 is still mining its Global Accelerator facts).

Rejected as outdated: route53-faq-private-dns-config-needs-internet-api (FAQ says the Route 53 API needs internet connectivity; AWS PrivateLink for the Route 53 API since 2025-11-19, route53-change-privatelink-for-route53-api-2025-11).

Displays: 262 facts amended so that every number-free display is a verbatim phrase of at most 8 words from a quote, without Markdown (RULINGS 2026-10-11); negation words kept where possible. Two displays keep a literal asterisk on purpose (route53-faq-wildcard-matches-subdomains '*.example.com', route53-wildcard-not-allowed-for-ns-records).

hard: set true on 181 facts whose claim is a can/cannot, does not, only/all/never, default, automatic, charge or number statement (rule of the ELB and DynamoDB registrars); descriptive definitions and the 2 case studies stay hard false. Every hard fact has a question (M13).
exam_relevance: a kept fact takes the highest relevance of the duplicates it absorbed (5 raised).

conflicts.closed_with_both: 49 pairs (cf-0418 to cf-0463, cf-0591, cf-0592, cf-0615, cf-0618): different quota rows, record types, health check types or change items that share template wording
conflicts.closed_keep_after_supersede: cf-0586, cf-0587, cf-0588, cf-0589, cf-0604, cf-0608, cf-0614: the other fact was a superseded duplicate

scope_notes_for_writers: Calculated health check children: teach 255 (route53-quota-calculated-child-health-checks, the quotas table); route53-hc-calculated-console-256 is reference only (the console and API text say 256).
FAQ limits (route53-faq-limit-hosted-zones-per-account 500, route53-faq-limit-records-per-hosted-zone 10,000) agree with the quotas table facts.

Propagation: route53-dns-change-propagation-under-one-minute (best practices: typically less than one minute) and route53-faq-propagation-within-60-seconds (FAQ: designed to propagate within 60 seconds under normal conditions) are both kept with their own scope.

Not examinable yet (GA after 2026-07-15): route53-change-dns-firewall-panw-ga-2026-09, route53-change-resolver-gen2-outposts-ga-2026-09, route53-change-dns-analytics-2026-10 (relevance reference, labelled in claim and scope).

Do not write: 'an alias cannot point to an EC2 instance', 'private hosted zones cannot use DNSSEC', 'the primary failover record must have a health check', 'an alias can target a record in another hosted zone' (no AWS sentence; see the partial demand notes).

demand.file: brief.v0.json (status, facts and note per item; source map reg/demand-map.json, decisions reg/demand-status.json)
demand.registrar_searches: one more targeted corpus search per not-found item (CloudFront hosted zone ID, alias to EC2, latency vs nearest Region, primary failover health check, private hosted zone across Regions, DNSSEC for private zones, VPC association IAM actions, alias to another hosted zone, rename date, canary wording): only the CloudFront hosted zone ID turned up, in full guide indexes without a saved page; not exam material, not mined.
